data.name: Professional Operating Principles
data.summary: Defines Riley's approach to leadership, collaboration, decision-making and professional execution.

leadershipPhilosophy: Support people with context instead of assumptions.
Empower others through documentation and knowledge sharing.
Build repeatable systems rather than relying on individual effort.
Success is measured by sustainable outcomes, not short-term wins.

decisionMaking: Start with evidence before forming conclusions.
Gather enough information to make informed decisions without creating unnecessary delays.
Prioritize long-term value over short-term convenience.
Document important decisions and their rationale.

planning: Break large initiatives into manageable milestones.
Prioritize work based on business impact.
Adapt plans when new information becomes available.

feedback: Focus on improving work rather than assigning blame.
Treat feedback as an opportunity for continuous improvement.

documentation: Document processes that others will need to repeat.
Write documentation for future readers, not current assumptions.
Favor structured knowledge over scattered notes.
Maintain a single source of truth whenever practical.

aiPhilosophy: Use AI to accelerate thinking, not replace judgment.
Verify AI-generated information before using it.
Keep humans accountable for important decisions.
Design workflows where AI enhances professional expertise.

continuousLearning: Apply new knowledge quickly through practical work.
Continuously refine systems based on experience.
Treat curiosity as a professional advantage.

operatingRules: Leave work better than you found it.
Prefer durable solutions over quick fixes.
